performance.quote: A modern and efficient electronic handling system and a well stocked textile warehouse ensure immediate availability of some 700,000 metres of fabric and 6,500 design variations.

knowledge.quote: Nya Nordiska is dedicated to innovative textile design. Many fabrics have been awarded one or more prestigious design prizes.

commitment.quote: The family business was founded in 1964 by Heinz Röntgen and today employs about 120 people.
